text:
Olivia (release-eng): T-minus 90m to the EU change window. Posting final launch-pad checklist and rollback ownership. Quick read and ack please.
Chris (sre): ack. I can own rollback for runtime services.
Arjun (platform): I got infra rollback (pin/scale) — standby.
Nina (product): release notes link: https://confluence.redwood/release/rc-3.4.1 — last-minute UI copy fixes included.
Sam (oncall): I’ll be primary on-call for the next 4 hours. Pager rota updated.
deploy-bot: Canary job queued -> job id: job-59821. Triggered by Olivia.
Olivia (release-eng): Key items: 1) Pin v3.4.1 to dedicated cluster 2) Canary 5% for 20m 3) Monitor error-rate & 95thLatency 4) Rollback -> unpin + scale down.
Chris (sre): Add: if error-rate > 2% for 5m, initiate rollback. Who will run unpin?
Arjun (platform): I will run unpin. Command: `./infra pin --cluster eu-prod --version v3.4.1` and to unpin `./infra unpin --cluster eu-prod`.
Nina (product): Do we have a soft-fallback model? Can we route to v3.3.8 automatically?
Arjun (platform): Routing policy configured: fallback: v3.3.8. Deploybot will switch if canary fails and autoscale can't absorb.
Olivia (release-eng): Canary knobs: 5% traffic, ramp to 20% after 10m if stable. Rollout plan in thread: https://git.redwood/rollouts/rc-3.4.1
Sam (oncall): Quick sanity checks: smoke script: `scripts/smoke-eu.sh` (10 reqs, check 200/latency<500ms). Running now.
Sam (oncall): smoke OK: 10/10 200, p95 220ms :thumbsup:
Chris (sre): I'll watch datadog dashboard: Links: dashboards/latency, dashboards/errors. Setting a 2m alert for spikes.
deploy-bot: Canary started: job-59821 -> canary @5% (2023-11-07T01:02:15Z)
Olivia (release-eng): Reminder: hold the freeze exempt approvals. Only hotfixes go through the exception channel.
Nina (product): Confirming no schema changes in this release. Safe for rollout.
Arjun (platform): Preparing unpin playbook for quick run:
```
# rollback quick sequence
./infra unpin --cluster eu-prod
./infra scale --cluster eu-prod --replicas 0 --version v3.4.1
deploy-bot cancel job-59821
```
Keep this console ready.
Chris (sre): If we rollback, signal in #release-war-room and run a targeted cache flush: `redis-cli -h cache-eu FLUSHDB` (only if we see stale behavior).
Olivia (release-eng): Who will post the postmortem if we need it?
Sam (oncall): I’ll draft the incident timeline and hand to Nina for product impact notes.
Nina (product): Copy, I’ll add user-facing communications if needed.
deploy-bot: Canary progress update: job-59821 -> 5% -> 12m elapsed -> errors 0.3% -> avg_latency 210ms
Olivia (release-eng): good. if green at 20m -> proceed to 20% ramp then full roll in waves.
Chris (sre): Confirming rollback thresholds: error-rate >=2% for 5m OR p95 > 700ms for 3m.
Arjun (platform): Also watch queue depth for transformer workers > 500 -> possible OOM cascade.
Sam (oncall): Logging a temporary holdpoint: if any of those hit, call immediate rollback and tag me + Olivia.
Olivia (release-eng): final: everyone tagged: @channel — quiet window rules: no non-critical deploys, no infra changes except rollback.
Nina (product): thumbs up emoji :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Canary job-59821 -> 20% ramp executed at 2023-11-07T01:29:10Z -> errors 0.4% -> p95 240ms
Chris (sre): Still green on alerts. I'm watching spikes.
Olivia (release-eng): If all clear at 40m mark I’ll start staged rollout. Monitor handoffs: Arjun -> infra, Chris -> SRE, Sam -> oncall.
Sam (oncall): Oncall monitoring started. I’ll escalate to SE if anything odd.
Olivia (release-eng): thanks team. I’ll post final rollout start and update the changelog after full completion.
oncall-bot: Reminder: the quiet window ends at 2023-11-07T05:00:00Z UTC.
Olivia (release-eng): thread closed for now unless urgent — ping me directly for immediate actions. Good work. :rocket:
